newsitem.title: USA: Montana Power to sell natgas property to UMC.
newsitem.headline: Montana Power to sell natgas property to UMC.

text.p: Montana Power Co announced Monday signing of a letter of intent to sell its natural gas production and gathering properties in three north central Montana counties to UMC Petroleum Corp of Houston, Texas for $6 million.

The deal includes all interests owned by Montana Power in Hill, Blaine and Chouteau counties--approximately 100 wells, five field compressor stations and associated gathering systems. The field produces five million cubic feet of natural gas per day.
The assets being sold do not include the natural gas transmission lines nor the Box Elder gas storage field.

In addition to the gas production and gathering systems, the sale includes all working, overriding royalty, reversionary, net profits, net revenue and any other interests in oil, gas and other mineral leases, equipment, all rights of way and easements.
UMC Petroleum Corporation is a subsidiary of the Houston-based United Meridian Corp.
The deal is expected to be completed within 60 days.
